project.name: nablatensor-lattice
project.description: A companion, deliberately non-adjoint lattice engine: recombining binomial trees (CRR, Jarrow-Rudd, Leisen-Reimer) with European / American / Bermudan exercise, tree Greeks, and a Richardson-extrapolated convergence table. Exists to cover the curriculum material (binomial trees, backward induction) that the record-and-replay Monte-Carlo engine cannot. Plain CPU, O(n^2), no tape.
